body: Famous Dex really knew how to turn up a crowd Famous Dex’s live performances of “OK DEXTER” were pure SoundCloud-era energy. He’d be all over the stage, jumping into the crowd, dancing and feeding off the chaos while everyone around him went crazy. Back in 2016, Dex was seen as one of the artists who could be just as big as Lil Uzi Vert @liluzivert and Playboi Carti He had the look, sound and internet presence that fit perfectly with that era of rap.

source_caption_text:
Famous Dex really knew how to turn up a crowd 😤🔥

Famous Dex’s live performances of “OK DEXTER” were pure SoundCloud-era energy. He’d be all over the stage, jumping into the crowd, dancing and feeding off the chaos while everyone around him went crazy.

Back in 2016, Dex was seen as one of the artists who could be just as big as Lil Uzi Vert and Playboi Carti. He had the look, sound and internet presence that fit perfectly with that era of rap.

Watching these old performances now shows just how much energy Dex brought to the underground. “OK DEXTER” was made for packed clubs and mosh pits, and those performances still capture what made that era so fun.

Via @famousdex
